headline: Plan your day at Hello Kitty World
subhead: Hello Kitty World helps families book tickets, reserve character meet-ups and map ride wait times before arriving at the park.
note: Free changes up to 24 hours before.
pageSummary: Your party of 4 has 6 activities planned for Saturday, with an estimated 38 minutes of total ride waiting.

chat.question: When is the shortest wait for the Teacup Spin on Saturday?
chat.answer: The Teacup Spin is usually quietest at 9:30 am, with an average wait of 6 minutes. Waits climb to about 22 minutes between 1:00 and 3:00 pm.
chat.followUp: Want me to add a 9:30 am ride slot to your plan?
